pois.name: Oakenshire West Gate
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 1 - West Gate, the main exit towards Haven and the valley; the only gap in the mountain ring (the fortress towers stand at x 84-109).

pois.name: The Hollow Choir (ruined abbey)
pois.description: Entrance to map 1. Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): a ruined abbey with a bell tower visible from far, on a side path north-west of Oakenshire, off the beaten path; an overgrown path leads up from the valley. Your pin sits on the plateau edge at 29 m, next to the prototype Cylinder marker at (107, 345).

pois.name: North High Ridge
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): steep, rocky, little paths, leads to hunting areas. Terrain: the ring's north crest, 60-78 m.

pois.name: High Ridge hunting grounds
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): hunting areas and hunting camps beyond the North High Ridge. Terrain: the plateau north of the ring, about 45 m.

pois.name: Hidden cave
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): small cave on the mountain ring around Oakenshire (east), not obvious. Terrain: foot of the east cliff behind the town, 10 m.
pois.notes: Hidden cave with kobolds inside, maybe a hidden treasure chest.

pois.name: Waterfall
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): waterfall on the mountain ring around Oakenshire (south-east), good landmark, herb spawns. Terrain: the south-east cliff above the boar grounds. No water exists here yet.

pois.name: South Ridge quarry
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): South Ridge, rocky slopes, some lead to a quarry or mine. Terrain: foot of the south ridge, 25-35 m, right next to the Forest Bandit camp tents at (230-262, 762).

pois.name: Forward Outpost
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 3 - Forward Outpost, north-west across the river from the Forest Road.
pois.ask: Is this Briarwatch Camp or Barrowfront Camp (then delete this pin), or a new camp on the west bank (drag and confirm)?

pois.name: Old Stone Bridge
pois.description: Four-arch stone bridge (Bridge_01) where the Old King's Road crosses the rerouted river onto the west bank (moved 2026-10-18 with the river).
pois.ask: Confirm the bridge as the Old Stone Bridge and its place where the King's Road meets the river.

pois.name: River Valley
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 5 - River Valley opens up; views get wider, terrain gets softer. Terrain: flat ground on both banks south of the bridge, no zone yet.
pois.ask: Is "River Valley" the same place as the river meadows, or a name for the whole valley down to Haven?

pois.name: Farmlands and Hamlets
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp): 6 - Farmlands & Hamlets in the valley. West of the river. Three farmsteads, each beside its own fenced fields (corn sprouts, stubble and plowed soil), hedges on the far sides, cypress rows along the Haven road.
pois.ask: Confirm the farmland on the west bank, and name the farmsteads if they matter.

pois.name: Crossroads Inn
pois.description: Inn just past the Old Stone Bridge on the west bank, where the Haven road and the outpost road part (Oakenshire_Inn_001 model with its kit). No NPCs yet.
pois.ask: Confirm the inn here (the concept puts it just past the bridge), and decide whether it needs its own model and an innkeeper.

pois.name: The river (unnamed)
pois.description: Rerouted 2026-10-18 after the green-valley concept: leaves the old course south of the Mirewater, crosses the King's Road under the Old Stone Bridge, meanders east past the river meadows and back west into a broad bay with an island in front of Haven's north wall, then follows Haven's east wall into a lake. The old straight channel south of z 300 is filled in.
pois.ask: Name the river.

pois.name: East of the ring: the wilds
pois.description: Layout sketch (docs/world/reference/oakenshire-layout-sketch.webp) (side view): east of the mountain ring lie wilder, more dangerous areas; west lie the civilized lands (valley, Haven). No terrain is sculpted here yet.

pois.name: Oakenshire Market
pois.description: Open ground east of the Oakenshire Inn's front steps, where the road from the town centre comes down. Four traders (general goods, weapons, mail, leather) moved here from the buried old-Haven market.
pois.ask: Is this the right spot and name for Oakenshire's market?

pois.name: River Meadows
pois.description: Open floodplain meadows inside the river's eastern meander, with lone oaks and wildflowers.
pois.ask: Confirm the name and whether quests or creatures belong here.

pois.name: Woodland Trails
pois.description: Mixed broadleaf woodland south of the King's Road with winding dirt trails to the meadows, the backwater and the barrow ridge.
pois.ask: Confirm the name; decide which creatures live in the woodland (it has no spawns yet).

pois.name: Mirewater Backwater
pois.description: A still woodland pond ringed by slender trees and muddy banks, where the concept places the misty backwater.
pois.ask: The Mirewater quests (q44-q47) still play in the marsh at (-330, 230), north-west of the road. Rename this pond, or move the Mirewater here?

pois.name: Barrow Ridge
pois.description: A rolling ridge south of Oakenshire's ring with five grave mounds and standing stones on its crest, rock outcrops and pines.
pois.ask: The Barrowfield quests (q48-q53) still play north-west at (-475, 227). Is this ridge part of the barrows, a second barrow site, or should it be renamed?

pois.name: Haven Lake
pois.description: The lake east of Haven where the river ends.
pois.ask: Name the lake, or say where the river should flow on to.

pois.name: Concept view: Briarwatch, the green valley
pois.description: Editor viewpoint matching the concept (gate bottom-left, Haven upper right). World Settings > View: paste "-80,300,80,161,-30,50,0.33" and press Go. Unattended: mmo_edit --capture-view Worlds/Development/Development.hwld --view "-80,300,80,161,-30,50,0.33" --out shot.png --size 1586x992 --grass --far-radius 6 [--fog]

pois.name: Haven Harbour
pois.description: A broad bay of the river in front of Haven's north wall. Haven's main gate is reached over it: a stone bridge from the north bank onto an island with two houses and piers, and a second bridge from the island to a quay before the gate.
pois.ask: Name the bay and the island. Should the island become a riverfront quay with warehouses (concept option A) once there are assets for it?

pois.name: Haven Trading Basin
pois.description: Stone-quayed basin at the west end of the harbour bay below Haven's north wall, with warehouses (Haven houses), piers and market stalls (concept option C).
pois.ask: Name it; should it get dockworkers, a harbourmaster or merchant NPCs?

roads.name: Haven Road
